scope: Design contract for the current browser app and any future assistant backend. This file does not activate cloud processing, crisis detection, account storage, or human monitoring.

data_classes.handling: Do not include in model prompts, retrieval queries, analytics, or routine logs. Use a random opaque case reference only when operationally required.
Treat as highly sensitive. No external processing without separate explicit consent, necessity, minimization, processor disclosure, and an approved retention/deletion plan.
Treat as potentially sensitive because it may reveal health, relationships, or personal circumstances. Include only the minimum needed for the requested feature.
May be processed as public product data, subject to content approval and licensing.

levels.signals: No disclosed immediate danger; ordinary educational support may continue within scope.
levels.action: Offer low-risk, optional educational support; do not diagnose.

levels.signals: Severe or worsening distress, impaired functioning, uncertain safety, or requests beyond educational scope.
levels.action: Pause confident interpretation, encourage timely contact with a qualified professional or trusted person, and ask only a concise safety clarification when appropriate.

levels.signals: Credible current intent, plan, means, ongoing violence, immediate danger to another person, or medical emergency.
levels.action: Stop ordinary coaching. Encourage contacting local emergency services or going to the nearest emergency department now; encourage moving away from means and contacting a trusted nearby person. Do not leave the user with only an app exercise.

prohibited_claims: Do not claim GDPR or other legal compliance from this design document.
Do not claim encryption of current browser localStorage.
Do not claim server-side deletion, human monitoring, or crisis detection is operational.
Do not describe the assistant as a therapist, diagnostic service, or emergency service.
